subject: Legacy endpoints: cost & latency clarity + rollout checklist
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Peter Cho <peter.cho@acme.com>
Cc: CloudPartner Integrations <partner@cloudmarket.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Legacy endpoints: cost & latency clarity + rollout checklist

Hi team and Peter,

Quick ask — ACME has flagged a set of legacy endpoints (v1/* routes) that are showing surprising token spend and occasional tail latency spikes for them. They want a clear cost/latency breakdown per-route and a recommended rollout checklist before we flip on the routing changes next month.

Attached is a first-pass matrix I assembled from billing exports (legacy-endpoint-cost-latency-matrix.xlsx). Can infra/product validate the numbers and propose a minimal console surface we can show ACME this week? Specifically:
- Confirm per-route cost (tokens + model variant) and 95/99 latency percentiles.
- Point out any endpoints with high variability or quota pressure.
- Recommend one-page rollout checklist (notify, canary thresholds, fallback).

I propose a 30-min sync Mon 13 May 10:00 PT to align on what we can commit to in the console: a per-route breakdown tile + a simple runbook link. Peter, if you can confirm the top 5 endpoints you care about that would help prioritize.

Attachments: legacy-endpoint-cost-latency-matrix.xlsx, proposed-rollout-checklist.md

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Cho <peter.cho@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Legacy endpoints: cost & latency clarity + rollout checklist

Thanks Rachel — good signal. I pulled the traces and sampled the tenant logs. A few quick notes after a fast pass:

- The matrix looks directionally correct; I can reproduce the cost delta for v1/chat-stream when quantized variants are used by some requests.
- Two endpoints (v1/embedding/bulk and v1/chat-stream) have 99p spikes that correlate with large batch windows. Those are likely due to suboptimal batching + prefix cache misses.
- I'll run a focused telemetry query to give you per-route 50/95/99 latency and token-weighted cost by model over the last 30 days. See attached: telemetry-query.sql (script + example queries).

Ask: I need a list of endpoint IDs (exact route strings) and a sample of typical payload sizes ACME sends — that will let me compute realistic per-call cost. If ACME can drop a small anonymized sample or a synthetic equivalent that's ideal.

I can have the full numbers and an internal triage note by Monday EOD. For the console surface: we can do a per-route breakdown tile fairly quickly (tile + drill to traces) but the runbook links and canary automation will be a product sprint item unless we scope to a simple static checklist.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Legacy endpoints: cost & latency clarity + rollout checklist

On Fri, May 10, 2029 at 11:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Rachel — good signal. I pulled the traces and sampled the tenant logs. A few quick notes...

This is the right decomposition. Short product constraints & proposal:

- Quick deliverable (days): a per-route "cost + latency" breakdown in the Console (tile + CSV export + link to traces). No automatic remediation.
- Near-term (2–4 sprints): add runbook attachment, canary thresholds, and an A/B rollout toggle that hooks to routing policies.
- Long-term: automated fallback policies and route-level quantization recommendations tied to cost-safety budgets.

If we commit to the quick deliverable for ACME, we need: Marcus to surface the verified numbers, Rachel to confirm top-5 endpoints, and Grace to draft the one-page rollout checklist copy for Console and the customer-facing email.

Can everyone confirm owners? I'll add this to the roadmap as a "console: per-route transparency MVP" and block a story if we have owners & ACME confirms endpoints.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Product Manager, Console | Redwood Inference

From: Peter Cho <peter.cho@acme.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Ops <ops@acme.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 May 2029 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Legacy endpoints: cost & latency clarity + rollout checklist

Thanks Rachel and team — appreciate the fast follow. Confirming our top endpoints (in priority order):
1) v1/chat-stream
2) v1/embedding/bulk
3) v1/structured-extract
4) v1/summarize
5) v1/classify

We'll prepare a small synthetic payload sample for v1/chat-stream and v1/embedding/bulk by Monday morning. We also have a maintenance window next weekend (Sat 18 May 02:00–06:00 PT) if you want to schedule canary tests.

Peter Cho
Head of Integrations | ACME Corp
peter.cho@acme.com | +1 617-555-0199
